uninstally is making waves in the Mobile ecosystem this week, gaining 17new stars. With a total of 281 stars on GitHub and 10 forks, this open-source project is rapidly becoming a go-to tool for developers worldwide.

Key Features

  • Written in Swift for maximum performance
  • Licensed under MIT — free to use and modify

Why uninstally Is Trending

The Mobile landscape is constantly evolving, and uninstally has emerged as one of the fastest-growing projects this week. Several factors contribute to its momentum:

  1. Growing community: With 17 new stars this week alone, developer adoption is accelerating rapidly.
  2. Active maintenance: The project sees regular updates, ensuring compatibility with the latest ecosystem changes.
  3. Practical utility: A clean, native macOS uninstaller. Completely removes apps and every file they leave behind using smart bundle-identifier detection. SwiftUI + Finder extension.

If you're working in Mobile, this is definitely a project worth watching — and adopting.

Quick Start

Get started with uninstally in minutes:

# Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/gostonx/uninstally # Navigate to project cd uninstally # Check the README for detailed setup instructions

For full documentation and advanced usage, visit the official GitHub repository.

Final Thoughts

uninstally is a solid addition to any developer's toolkit. With its growing community, active development, and practical design, it's well worth your time to evaluate. Star it on GitHub, try it in a side project, and see if it fits your workflow.
